steps.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production creature portrait for dark gothic fantasy game Heroes of Orvesk. Single vertical 1024x1536 image, head and upper shoulders, three-quarter view looking toward IMAGE LEFT. Directional key light from ABOVE FRONT IMAGE LEFT; light must not be mirrored with pose. Deep charcoal near-black background. Sculptural three-dimensional modeling, aged bone and coarse worn fabric textures, fine grain like an old fantasy illustration, muted bone/graphite palette. Visually referenced style: weathered dense volume and restrained edge highlights from a bronze-armored portrait; gothic graphite angular forms; old ivory linen in deep shadow. Do NOT reproduce reference frames or characters. Anatomically convincing human skeletal skull, jaw, neck vertebrae and shoulder bones; genuinely dead and animated, no living flesh, not a masked person. Sinister quiet purpose, not comic. Bone fissures and deep empty eye sockets with no neon glow. Readable silhouette at small size. NO weapons, no shield, no bow, no arrows, no quiver, no hands, no armor, no text, no labels, no borders, no logos. Distinct character design. Subject: ordinary reanimated skeleton sentry. Broad weathered skull, small old chip on upper left frontal bone, intact jaw and most teeth, bare crown, yellow-grey porous bone, short ragged strip of faded burial linen hanging low around neck and clavicles. Squared steady head posture, large skull fills upper composition. Shoulder joints and a little exposed rib cage visible below. No helmet or hood.
